design.title: Kefi Tech — Data Analytics & Data Engineering for Education
design.style_name: Kefi Brand v6 + Visual Fixes + REAL Industry-Specific Content
design.logo_discipline: ONE LOGO PER SLIDE. Only slides 1 (cover) and 12 (closing) get the actual Kefi Tech logo image. All other 10 slides use `KEFI TECH`. Foot-rail on EVERY slide uses the text wordmark.

logo.sizing_lock: Width-locked classes with padding-left to prevent logo overlap with brand stripe.

design.v6_fixes_applied: Fix 1 (logo padding-left), Fix 2 (taller COMPONENTS panel 400px), Fix 3 (architecture justify-content space-between), Fix 4 (full capability names on cover), Fix 5 (industry-specific architecture content — 320 real entries).

slides.title: Cover — Data Analytics & Data Engineering for Education
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Apply .brand-stripe (6px left edge, top 60% #004c97, bottom 40% #ff6c0e). Top-left: `` (260px wide, with 10px left padding to clear brand stripe) at top:64px / left:104px. Top-right: small JetBrains Mono 'DATA ANALYTICS AND DATA ENGINEERING SERVICES · 2026' in --text-muted. Center-left (~y=240): eyebrow 'KEFI TECH · EDUCATION' in --brand; huge display headline at --fs-display (64px) on two stacked lines (Sora 700/800): line 1 'Data Analytics & Data Engineering' in --primary, line 2 'for Education.' in --accent orange. Below headline: thin --accent-bar (48px wide). Below accent-bar: a real subtitle in --text-secondary at --fs-h3: 'A capability brief on Kefi Tech Data Analytics & Data Engineering Services for Education.' Right side: vertical hairline at ~70% width with three stacked JetBrains Mono callouts in --brand. FIX 4: Use FULL capability names (not single words): '01 Data Strategy & Governance', '02 Data Engineering & Integration', '03 Data Platforms & Modernization'. Apply .grid-bg subtle background grid. NO secondary stat. NO CTA. Clean and quiet. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; right '01 / 12 · DATA ANALYTICS AND DATA ENGINEERING SERVICES'.

slides.title: Industry Context — Education
slides.task_brief: Industry context slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT · EDUCATION' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'Education is being reshaped by digital learning, institutional automation and student lifecycle intelligence.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Student success, faculty productivity, institutional efficiency and digital experience define modern education.'. Below subtitle: a TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT column (55% width): a .surface-elev panel (~560px x 360px) titled 'WHY EDUCATION NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow in --brand). Below, a stacked list of 4 industry drivers, each as a small .surface card with: Material Icon (20px) in --brand + Sora 600 driver title (13px) + Inter 11px --text-secondary description (2 lines). Verbatim drivers — 'trending_up' 'Digital transformation pressure' / 'Enterprise digital adoption accelerating across the industry.' 'shield' 'Regulatory & compliance demands' / 'Industry-specific regulations require continuous compliance technology.' 'speed' 'Operational efficiency mandate' / 'Cost-to-serve reduction while maintaining quality and resilience.' 'group' 'Customer & employee expectations' / 'Modern digital experiences are now table stakes, not differentiation.' RIGHT column (45% width): a .surface-elev panel (~440px x 360px) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DATA ANALYTICS & DATA ENGINEERING' (eyebrow in --accent-dark). Below, Inter 13px --text-secondary body text (line-height 1.7): 'Data Analytics & Data Engineering applied to education requires industry-specific capability, not generic technology. The right approach connects data analytics & data engineering to the regulatory, operational and customer realities that define education.' Below body: a small .tag-pill 'INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC APPROACH' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '02 / 12'; right 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT'.

Verbatim pillars — 1 'Data strategy, maturity assessment, architecture, governance, lineage, MDM.' 'Data Strategy & Governance' / 'lightbulb' 2 'Data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, integration, migration, data quality.' 'Data Engineering & Integration' / 'storage' 3 'Data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, cloud data platforms, legacy modernization.' 'Data Platforms & Modernization' / 'cloud' 4 'Enterprise dashboards, reporting, KPI frameworks, self-service BI, executive analytics.' slides.title: Engagement Pathway
slides.task_brief: Engagement pathway slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'A four-stage pathway from discovery to operations.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Each stage carries concrete deliverables, a fixed duration, and a transparent commercial frame.' 4-column grid of FOUR .pathway-stage cards (each ~270px wide x ~360px tall, gap-4). Apply .pathway-stage.accent to card 4. Each card: .pathway-stage-num + .pathway-stage-name + .pathway-stage-meta + hairline-soft + 'DELIVERABLES' eyebrow + deliverables list + .pathway-stage-fee at bottom. Verbatim — STAGE 01 'Discovery' meta '2 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Data Analytics & Data Engineering maturity assessment', 'Opportunity prioritization', '90-day roadmap', 'ROI business case'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture', 'CoE charter', 'Governance framework', 'Build plan'. Fee: '$50K-$150K'. STAGE 03 'Delivery' meta '8-24 WEEKS · T&M OR FIXED'. Deliverables: 'Production system', 'Integration complete', 'Documentation', 'Knowledge transfer'. Fee: '$300K-$1M'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'. NO .pull-quote. NO CTA button. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '10 / 12'; right 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY'.
